fixtureCorrections.migrationBuild: Qualified the existing public enum/return types because forward migrations run after a baseline with an empty search_path; no change to function types or ACL.
fixtureCorrections.historicalApproval: The real owner_id helper intentionally trusts only session_user loop_app; use the real application authorization instead of assuming a postgres session plus loop.owner_id is sufficient.
fixtureCorrections.workerClaim: Configure the required isolated scheduler capacity; keep the missing-capacity rejection intact.
fixtureCorrections.historyProjection: Use the fixture actual database rather than its empty schema template; compare the real projector before/after retirement.
fixtureCorrections.savedReview: Pass the mandatory current review package ID. A stale-package 409 is a protection and cannot stand in for retirement rejection.
fixtureCorrections.workerIsolation: Put the preserved running generated task in a separate episode so it does not affect the independent old storyboard approval contract.
fixtureCorrections.savedReviewValidBaseline: For an unsupported script target old review selects the visual review branch first; provide a real current visual package, actual bytes and visual_review stage to reach and verify its 400 target rejection. Do not count stale-stage/package 409 as retirement proof.
fixtureCorrections.storyboardFrozenInputs: The generic Studio fixture has no frozen script/visual inputBasis. For a real old Owner approval, supply actual main-script and visual manifests in both file and frozen package; keep the artifact/input verification unchanged.
fixtureCorrections.wakeNotification: A successful old review notifies the scheduler after COMMIT. Observe this notification instead of throwing a fake generation error; assert all 46 real Worker ports reject draft_script, no new tasks, no paid reservation and no Provider preflight.
fixtureCorrections.uniqueApprovals: Each saved package approves its own new revision of the actual frozen storyboard. Re-approving one shared package violates the existing unique approval constraint; preserve that constraint and all old approval rows.
